name: Skills-Manager
description: Free, open-source desktop manager for AI Agent Skills. Write a skill once, sync it to 32 AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more) via symlinks. Local-first, MIT licensed. macOS, Windows, Linux.

capability_evidence.skills-plugins: tarized by Apple, so the cask strips the quarantine attribute on install — see the tap README for what that means and how to opt out.
capability_evidence.gui-desktop: ommand-line tool ships with every release for terminal-first workflows: SSH/headless machines, dotfiles setup scripts, and quick status checks.
capability_evidence.cross-agent-support: Mentions Claude Code, Cline, Codex, Cursor

friction.note_en: Turnkey. install via Homebrew install, native installer / package; GUI application
friction.note_zh: 开箱即用。可通过 Homebrew install、native installer / package 安装；GUI application

analysis.summary_en: Skills Manager is a modern desktop application designed to solve the fragmentation of AI assistant skills configurations.
highlights: ⚡ High Performance: Built with Rust and Tauri 2.0 for a lightweight, blazing-fast experience.
🛡️ Cross-Platform: Native support for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
🎨 Modern UI: Beautiful Raycast-style interface built with React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, and Radix UI.
🎯 Unified Management: Centralize all your AI skills in one secure location.
highlights_zh: 🔌 多工具支持：开箱即用支持 32 款 AI 工具（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Windsurf、Trae、Cline、Augment、Goose 等），并支持自定义扩展。
🔄 智能同步：自动化的软链接管理，确保您的工具始终使用最新版本的技能，无需手动复制文件。
🛡️ 跨平台支持：完美支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 系统。
🎛️ 灵活控制：无需删除源文件，即可随时针对特定工具启用或禁用某个 Skill。
